structured_output.what_is_happening: A 9-day-old pump.fun coin that has already migrated to PumpSwap ("Togi Coin", with fees going to @shanestoffer) came back to life sharply. It is up about 2,000% in 6 hours and 250%+ in the last hour, to about $86k market cap, on $97k of hourly volume. There were 342 unique buyers in the last hour and ~411 over 6h, so almost all of this activity is new. In the last few hours, a swarm of same-ticker TOGI copies has launched (ShaneStoffer, TOGI COIN, TOGICOIN and others). That points to live off-chain attention around a Shane Stoffer / "Señor Togi" story. At detection the move is cooling: GeckoTerminal's 5-minute volume is $4.3k against $45k over 15 minutes, 5-minute sellers (38) outnumber buyers (26), and price is about 29% below the all-time high.

narrative.description: A character or personality meme ("Señor Togi") tied to X user shanestoffer, who receives the creator fees. Probably a streamer or influencer fee-sharing coin that he or his audience is now pushing.
narrative.why_spreading: About 8 copycat TOGI tokens launched within the last ~1-2 hours, which usually means someone posted about Togi off-chain and people are hunting for the ticker. The older, migrated coin with fees going to the named account is the obvious place for that demand to land.

token_connection.why_this_token: The project's X handle and fee recipient is shanestoffer. It is the oldest migrated TOGI with real liquidity ($26k) and the only one with meaningful market cap. The copies are all fresh and worth about $3-4k.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Two older "The Roaring Bull" TOGI tokens have dead volume. Several fresh copies (ShaneStoffer, TOGI, TOGI COIN, TOGICOIN, Factually I Could) sit at about $3-4k with small volume.

authenticity.evidence: The breadth of new buyers looks real: 342 unique buyers in 1h and 589 holders, with copycat launches as a sign of attention. GMGN also shows 35 smart and 4 renowned wallets. Against that: 309 bundler-tagged wallets, a 78% bot/degen rate, and a dev X account linked to 320 launched tokens, which suggests a serial fee-launch account. The insider transfer networks and the GeckoTerminal top-10 figure of 91% (which likely includes pool accounts) are unclear.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data to confirm whether shanestoffer actually posted or endorsed the coin, and no way to tell organic attention from call-channel attention.

structural_risks: Momentum is decaying at the decision point: 5-minute volume collapsed and sellers outnumber buyers
A +2,000% move in 6h leaves many holders sitting on large profits they can take
Bundler-heavy trader base with a high bot share
The dev X account is tied to 320 token launches, so the fee-recipient pattern may be serial
The ticker is crowded with copies that split attention

structured_output.counterargument: Copycat swarms and a 342-buyer first hour are the classic signs of a narrative that is still growing. The coin with fees to the named personality is the canonical play, and a further leg from $86k to $170k+ is a small move if the personality keeps promoting it. On the other side, the structure is clean: LP burned, authorities renounced, no creator holdings.

structured_output.thesis: This is a revived migrated coin with real breadth of buyers and signs of a live off-chain story: copycats and a personality receiving the fees. That puts it above the typical coin in this pool. Buying after a 20x run in 6h while 5-minute flow is fading lowers the odds of a clean 2x before a -50% drop. The LP is burned, so a rug is less likely than a slow bleed.
